title: Question 22
passage:
I thought this market was open every Saturday.
A. Usually, but it closes once a month for a deep clean. B. I always buy mushrooms here. C. The nearest supermarket is two streets away.
passageZh:
我以為這個市集每週六都開。
A. 通常是，不過每月會休市一次，進行全面清潔。 B. 我都在這裡買蘑菇。 C. 最近的超市隔了兩條街。
